connector.name: TweekIT MCP Server by tweekit.io
connector.registryDescription: Normalize and convert 400+ file types via TweekIT's hosted MCP endpoint.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.tweekit.io over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.tweekit, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: ApiKey
headers.description: TweekIT API key issued from the TweekIT account portal.

headers.name: ApiSecret
headers.description: API secret paired with the ApiKey for authenticated conversions.
